understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+'. The level, and then the game, is won when all goals are occupied.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved by clicking reachable positions or using directional movement. Walls and obstacles block movement; clicking an unreachable or blocked destination has no effect but consumes a step. Pieces can move through open paths, and the run has a finite step budget. Multiple pieces must be positioned on separate goals at the same time.
